title: GOD'S TENDER COMFORT
ISAIAH 66:13 RESTORATION PRAYER
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

scenes.a: Your heart is weary from carrying everyone else.
You hold every broken piece in quiet silence while nobody asks how you are doing today. The Lord sees your hidden exhaustion.
scenes.sub: THE LORD SEES YOUR QUIET PAIN

scenes.a: Hear his promise in Isaiah chapter sixty-six, verse thirteen: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
Father, wrap this tired soul in your soothing presence right now.
Where grief has left a deep ache, bring the tender warmth only your spirit gives.
Soften their pain and quiet every restless thought in your mercy. Amen. Your heart is weary.
